name: Mock Up
source:
Aster's gaze hardens as she meets Muyi’s eyes. 'Stop pretending you can save anyone. This place is already broken, and all we’ll ever know is pain'...

[From [url=https://omulili.itch.io/mock-up-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当艾斯特与穆伊的目光相遇时，她的眼神变得冷酷起来。“别再假装你能拯救任何人。这个地方已经破碎了，我们所知道的只有痛苦……”

[来自[url=https://omulili.itch.io/mock-up-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
